EmailTemplate.subject: Webinar Tomorrow…Using actionable data to address education affordability
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {{lead.First Name:default=Friend}},
Does your institution have a way to ease the student financial process and accelerate cash flow while improving student retention?
Join our webinar "Embracing Change: Using actionable data to address education affordability <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/webinar-embracing-change-using-actionable-data-to-address-education-affordability]]>” on Thursday, July 27th at 12 PM ET for an insightful panel with student account leaders. We will discuss how these leading higher ed institutions are using innovative technology and actionable data to address affordability and keep more students enrolled.
Speakers:
- Isaiah Behnke, Director, Student Account Operations, University of Virginia - Brandon Cline-Taskey, Director, University Business Office, James Madison University - Sara Rosenberger, Student Accounts & Loan Coordinator, Reed College - Paul McWhorter, Product Manager, Flywire
